entities.summary: Tommy Portimo (b. 1981-09-05, Kemi) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Kemi and Finland. Known in the fields of finland, composers & musicians, europe.
